summary: Iteration 22: verified all 7 reported changes. Seeded custom strategy 'Mein Test Strat' (custom_test9999) + closed trade into local Mongo, then validated backend slippage-stats name resolution/days-clamping via new pytest file (12/12 pass), ran the 3 requested unit-test files (16/16 pass), and verified frontend via Playwright on the preview URL: slippage card shows the clear name, TradeDetailCard ladder no longer contains peak/trough rows while meta still shows them, and StrategyAutoTradeModal has no require-all checkbox but still has the pre-signals checkbox. No regressions found; all checks green.
